title: Migration and remittances: families between Central America and the United States
goal: Explain why people leave El Salvador and Honduras and what remittances do, with debido a and a raíz de.
grammar: formal cause connectors: debido a, a raíz de (review)

sections.title: Migration and remittances: families between Central America and the United States
body: In this lesson you read about migration from El Salvador and Honduras and about the money migrants send home. The text is in Spanish; the screens and instructions are in English.
The grammar is the one you know for giving a cause in a formal way: *debido a* and *a raíz de*.

items: I can give a cause with *debido a* and *a raíz de* and a noun.
I can say why many people leave El Salvador and Honduras.
I can explain what remittances are and what families use them for.
